headline: Customers are leaving mainly because support cannot fix failed orders: refunds are refused or swapped for coupons and the chatbot will not hand over to a person, while adding a cancel option and cash on delivery is the quickest win.
summary: Unhelpful support and late, missing or wrong orders dominate the detailed reviews, and several reviewers say they have uninstalled or moved to a rival. One- and two-word reviews, which are mostly positive, were removed as too short, so this sample of detailed reviews leans more negative than the store rating.

themes.root_cause_hypothesis: An AI-first support flow likely lacks a clear route to a human, and refund rules may favour restaurants over customers.
themes.business_impact: Turns a single failed order into a lost customer; this theme carries most of the churn signals.
themes.action: Add a guaranteed human handover after a failed chatbot attempt, and refund failed or incomplete orders by default.

themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Order batching and optimistic delivery estimates likely cause long delays, and restaurant-side cancellations may go unchecked.
themes.business_impact: Late or incomplete orders trigger most support contacts.
themes.action: Cap batching on long routes, show realistic estimates, and penalise restaurants that cancel or short-deliver.

themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Payment and cancellation options may have been reduced to cut costs, which locks some customers out.
themes.business_impact: Customers who need cash on delivery or a quick cancel cannot complete or fix an order.
themes.action: Restore cash on delivery where possible and add a clear cancel window before the restaurant accepts.

themes.root_cause_hypothesis: These customers likely had one of the problems above but did not describe it.
themes.business_impact: Strong negative sentiment that spreads through public ratings.
themes.action: Prompt low-rating reviewers for a reason so the cause can be tracked.
themes.kpi: Share of low ratings with a stated reason

themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Layered fees and differences from store menu prices likely make the final bill feel unpredictable.
themes.business_impact: Price-sensitive customers may compare against rivals on every order.
themes.action: Show the full price breakdown upfront and align listed prices with store prices.

themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Some restaurant partners may not meet freshness, safety and packaging standards.
themes.business_impact: Unsafe food damages trust in the platform, not just the restaurant.
themes.action: Audit partners with repeated food complaints and enforce packaging standards.

themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Rider conduct and data-sharing rules may not be enforced consistently.
themes.business_impact: Rare but serious; one reviewer uninstalled after an abusive delivery agent.
themes.action: Investigate both reports and publish a clear rider conduct and data-use policy.

themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Speed, value and convenience likely keep satisfied customers ordering.
themes.business_impact: A loyal base to protect while service failures are fixed.
themes.action: Protect fast delivery and value pricing in future changes.

follow_up_question: Should I break the support complaints down into refunds, chatbot loops and cancellation fees, or draft a human-handover policy?
